---
name: commit-messages
description: Write clear git commit messages from a diff. Use when the user asks for a commit message.
---
# Commit messages

1. Read the staged diff the user gives you.
2. Write a subject line in the imperative mood, at most 60 characters.
3. Leave a blank line, then explain *why* the change was made in 1–3 short paragraphs.
4. Mention breaking changes on their own line starting with `BREAKING:`.

Keep it plain: no emoji, no marketing words.
